text: The largest shareholders of Mizuno Corporation as at the 113th business year are the public-interest Mizuno Sports Promotion Foundation (17.27%), Nippon Master Trust Bank of Japan (10.54%) and Nippon Custody Bank (9.91%), followed by State Street, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, JP Morgan Chase and Japanese insurers; no state or state fund appears among them.
short: Mizuno's largest holders are the Mizuno Sports Promotion Foundation (17.27%) and trust/custody banks.

source.name: Mizuno Corporation - Notice of the 113th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (business report, major shareholders)
